text:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: yesterday's outage from upstream auth rate-limits. Root cause: burst-refresh pattern from our token refresh + vendor dynamic throttling. 12% model-registry call failures during the spike.

sahil: Thanks for the writeup. What are immediate stopgap items?

ellie: Quick wins I listed in the doc: 1) client-side soft rate limiter; 2) short-lived token cache with fallback; 3) synthetic token probe to detect vendor throttling.

maya: Can we assign owners + target dates? This is a repeating class of failures across providers, so we need durable fixes.

ellie: I'll own the probe/runbook updates. ETA: 2025-03-08. Deliverables: probe + dashboard panels + alerting rule.

kyle: I'll own SDK changes: exponential backoff + jitter + local cache TTL override. PR by 2025-03-06, canary to Dedicated same week.

james: I'll chase vendor for documented burst limits and ask for a sandbox env. Expect reply by 2025-03-05.

maya: I'll coordinate the retro and set up a quarterly "burst-refresh" drill. Owner?

sahil: I can run the drill program. Will create a recurring calendar invite and a test plan.

maya: Consolidated actions -> please open tickets: 
- R1: runbook + synthetic probe -> ellie -> due 2025-03-08
- R2: SDK backoff + cache -> kyle -> due 2025-03-06
- R3: vendor limits & sandbox -> james -> due 2025-03-05
- R4: dashboard + anomaly alerts -> ellie -> due 2025-03-08
- R5: canary rollout plan -> kyle -> due 2025-03-09
- R6: quarterly drill schedule -> sahil -> first drill 2025-04-01

ellie: For R4 I'll add token-exchange latency p50/p95/p99 + sudden delta detection. Also include histogram of vendor X-RateLimit-* headers in traces.

kyle: Example config (will be in PR):
```yaml
auth:
  strategy: "exp_jitter"
  max_retries: 6
  max_backoff_ms: 2500
  local_token_cache_s: 20
  enable_soft_rate_limit: true
```

ops-bot: Retro scheduled: Wed 2025-03-11 10:00am PT in #incidents. Auto-invite: maya, sahil, ellie, kyle, james, platform-eng.

deploy-bot: Note: runbook PR opened by ellie (/docs/runbooks/burst-refresh.md) - PR #2102.

maya: Two other notes: 1) instrument vendor headers into our spans for correlation; 2) add a short-lived admission control that mutes aggressive refreshes during detected vendor throttles.

sahil: For the drill, propose KPIs: <1% regression to model-registry error-rate in test burst, detection time < 30s, and auto-fallback success rate > 95%.

james: Vendor replied: they will share rate-limit docs tom morning and offered a sandbox for us to test 1hr load windows. I'll coordinate access.

kyle: I'll include a feature-flag for the local cache TTL and backoff so we can toggle quickly if any regressions.

ellie: Adding a checklist section to the runbook: how to run the synthetic probe, how to interpret rate-limit headers, rollback steps.

maya: Please create the issues tonight and link back to the postmortem. I'll verify owners and close actions in the retro. Treat this as P0 cross-team until R1-R5 are complete.

(END)
